registration.rule: Source and baseline coordinate system is fixed by unchanged global anchors; evaluate all nine candidate shifts against source using the same mask eroded by2px. Compare candidate and baseline under the same shifts; never optimize masks or move each wing independently.
registration.resampling: Integer pixels only; no scaling or image warping.

metrics.fixedSourceSupport: Before seeing candidates, source pixels inside fixed mask with B>90 and B-R>35 and B-G>5. Excludes white/gray labels; report sensitivity at B>80 and B>110 too. Freeze support.
metrics.candidateSupport: Same thresholds on baseline/candidate within fixed mask. Empty support is a failure, not zero distance.
metrics.sourceRecall: Fraction of fixed source-support pixels having candidate support within 2px; also report within1px and3px. Recall must not decline from baseline for either wing; this prevents gain by erasing required source details.
metrics.symmetricDistance: Mean and 95th-percentile Euclidean nearest-support distances both directions, computed separately by wing. No empty-set shortcut. Recall gate applies even if average improves.
metrics.photometric: Masked RGB MAE and blue/cyan/violet channel profile summaries; report separately per wing and for all9 paired registrations. MAE improvement without sourceRecall/symmetricDistance evidence is insufficient.
metrics.ridgeProfile: Inspect several unoccluded ridge cross-sections selected from baseline/Source before trial evaluation. Report sharp-core width, peak/halo luminance, and position. Do not register away the vertical-translation candidate.
metrics.spill: Root must compare changed pixels outside allowed decorative wave/junction layer against baseline. Geometry trials can occupy newly empty wing background but may not overwrite metric text, core paint or orbit. Mask cannot establish this by itself.

decision: Trials only. Require no sourceRecall regression per wing, no worsening symmetric p95 per wing, and repeatable paired photometric/spatial benefit; inspect full context. If brightness and spatial metrics conflict, report conflict and retain baseline unless visual evidence resolves it. Report metric denominators/visible support sizes; no whole-source percentage.
